Overview
The
Root cause analysis of low yellow fever vaccination coverage
tool focuses on districts with insufficient routine immunization coverage. It includes a practical methodology and questionnaire to identify operational, policy, provider and community-related barriers to vaccination. The tool explores potential underlying causes such as inaccurate coverage estimates, missed sessions, stock-outs, workforce constraints, vaccine hesitancy and access barriers. It is designed to inform targeted recovery plans and strengthen routine immunization systems in high-risk settings.
